decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The access doorway to the premises shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for a wine bar, shall not take place anywhere on the site except within the building.
Condition : 5 - No amplified or other music shall be played in the premises outside the following times:10:00am to 11:00pm on weekdays and Saturdays11:00am to 9:00pm on Sundays and Bank Holidays
Condition : 6 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted for a wine bar shall not begin until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound between the wine bar and the adjoining residential and commercial units (including upper floor flats), has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The submitted scheme shall include provision of means of ventilation to allow the use to operate with windows shut at all times and any doors being self closing and all such windows and doors shall be kept shut while the wine bar is open.. The measures so approved shall be implemented prior to the use commencing and shall be permanently retained thereafter.
description: Change of use from A1 use to wine bar (A4)
